slug: 2023-11-27 Setting the agenda for digital transformation

facts.fact: In a ministerial interview (advertorial), the minister of digital transformation describes the National Digital Transformation Agenda 2022-2025 as built on four axes and cites a plan to invest at least 30 million dollars over two years in fibre backbone projects, one component; no total cost for the agenda is given.

The minister says 12 of 26 ministerial departments had been digitalised for mail processing and an integrated schools-enrolment system had eliminated 500,000 duplicate document requests; he measures these against nothing in the agenda.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Modernization of the Administration
systems.tiers: national; four axes: digital infrastructure, digital government administration, transformation of economic sectors, e-business and innovation
presented to the Council of Ministers in September 2023

note: Advertorial interview; ministerial self-presentation. Class national follows the four axes the piece gives.
